architecture: Existing EdgeTypeGNN with mean node pooling + mask-aware GRU + concatenation + sigmoid direct-score head; EPSS-only omits the graph branch.
initialization: For each seed, save one graph-fusion initial state and reuse it for all three edge modes. EPSS-only has a separate state. Output bias uses training-target mean only.
batch_order: Generate all 100 epoch orders once per seed and share across all four variants; stopping may differ but common epochs have identical orders.
checkpoint_selection: Earliest strictly lowest validation MAE. Improvement requires MAE < best MAE, with min_delta=0. Stop after 15 consecutive non-improving epochs or epoch 100.

evaluation.aggregation: Report every seed and mean plus sample standard deviation across three seeds; never select the best seed. Persistence is deterministic, not three independent runs.
evaluation.matched_comparison: Report each seed's paired MAE differences versus persistence, EPSS-only and no_coref on identical validation CVEs. Descriptive comparisons, not independent confirmatory tests.

limitations: Current descriptions are not verified historical Day-30 descriptions; this remains retrospective.
SecBERT pretraining cutoff and exact historical EPSS release times remain unverified.
Validation has informed development repeatedly; it is not a final unbiased performance estimate.
Only explicit COREF edges vary; mention nodes and other coreference-derived structure remain.
Security relations are candidates; fixed extraction rules do not establish semantic correctness.
